title: Binance Options Will Launch Additional BNBUSDT Daily Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch additional BNBUSDT Daily Options on  2023-08-30  at  08:00 (UTC) .   Please note:   BNBUSDT Daily Options are European-style options contracts. Binance will launch T+3 BNBUSDT Daily Options on  2023-08-30  at  08:00 (UTC) . Thereafter, T+3 BNBUSDT Daily Options will be listed every day at  08:00 (UTC) . Please note that there will be no new T+3 BNBUSDT Daily Options listing if it coincides with the expiration of a BNBUSDT Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly options contract that day. BNBUSDT Daily Options will have a trading lifetime of three days and expire at 08:00 (UTC).  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-08-29
